description:
You are developing a simple ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) prototype pipeline for a data engineering project. Your goal is to extract the main text content from the page at https://example.com using a headless browser (such as with the `lynx` or `w3m` browser utilities in dump mode, or via a tool like `curl` for simple HTML extraction if textual browsers are unavailable).

Extract only the visible text that appears on the loaded https://example.com homepage (excluding all HTML tags, scripts, and comments—only user-visible body text), and write this plain text output to a file at /home/user/etl_raw_data/scraped_examplecom.txt.

The text file must include exactly the text as rendered/seen by a user visiting https://example.com in a text-based browser, including any visible title or heading, separated by a single blank line, preserving the line breaks as shown in the browser output. Do not include any headers, footers, command prompts, or browser status lines. Make sure the /home/user/etl_raw_data directory exists before saving the file.

No other files should be created. Return to the terminal a brief message confirming extraction.
